title: ‘I just got lucky’: Coin flip determines newest member of Salt Lake City Council
summary: A former staff member for Gov. Spencer Cox and Salt Lake Tribune editor won a coin flip to become the newest Salt Lake City Council member.

title: Jobs in SLC that you don’t actually hate
summary: Hey guys I thought I’d make a post on here looking for job opportunities. What do you guys do that you don’t absolutely hate doing for work? Can anyone make a good recommendation for a job/career that doesn’t necessarily require a degree that pays more than $35 an hour? I make $29 an hour now at a warehouse that I’ve been at for 3 years and I don’t even necessarily like it. I’m just there for the money at the moment and I’m still scraping by after all the bills
